title: Wildflowers
intro: Wildflowers. Growing where nobody planted them.
cover: A single orange flower growing under glass, with a big astronaut glove reaching in gently.

title: Listening Time
intro: Listening Time. Headphones on, nowhere to be.
cover: An astronaut with headphones on, sitting on a bench, the title glowing behind.

title: Warm Tape
intro: Warm Tape. A wall of cassettes and a guitar that remembers.
cover: An astronaut in orange at a wall of cassettes, holding one up, a boombox below.
sound: Lofi hip hop instrumental. Soulful vintage guitar melodies over a boom bap beat, vinyl crackle, warm tape feel.

title: Downtown Nightlight
intro: Downtown Nightlight. The city's still awake, and so are we.
cover: An astronaut sitting on a rooftop above a city at night, the title written in stars.

title: Cafe Opens At Midnight
intro: Cafe Opens At Midnight. Corner table's open.
cover: An astronaut barista pouring coffee at a counter, a neon sign, stars out the window.

title: The Long Drive Home
intro: The Long Drive Home. Just you and the dashboard glow.
cover: An astronaut at the wheel, seen from the back seat, a city glowing through the windshield.
sound: Atmospheric lofi instrumental. Melancholic electric piano over a soft beat. Made for a late night drive or a rainy day.

title: Let's Stay In Tonight
intro: Let's Stay In Tonight. Good call.
cover: An astronaut lying on a rug, surrounded by records, books, a guitar, pizza and string lights.
sound: Soulful boom bap instrumental. Jazzy keyboard progression, vinyl grit, quiet night in energy.

title: On A Different Frequency
intro: On A Different Frequency. Tune in close.
cover: An astronaut sitting in a room stacked with old TVs, most of them showing static.

title: Velvet & Brass
cover: A black silhouette playing a trumpet in front of a red velvet curtain.
sound: Cinematic jazzy hip hop instrumental. Cool and soulful, for a lonely walk home through the city.

title: Junkyard Jazz
intro: Junkyard Jazz. Beautiful noise from the scrap pile.
cover: An astronaut on a scrap heap of old horns under a full moon, a battered sax in front.

title: The Keys Just Know Me
intro: The Keys Just Know Me. Hands on the keys, eyes closed.
cover: Black and white. A gloved astronaut hand resting on the keys of an upright piano.
sound: Cinematic lofi instrumental. Atmospheric synth pad, clean introspective keyboard melody. A musician alone with the instrument late at night.

title: Falling In Love With The Light
intro: Falling In Love With The Light. Let it in.
cover: An astronaut watching the northern lights over water, the title written in the aurora.

title: Hummingbird
intro: Hummingbird. Slow down and catch it.
cover: A bright hummingbird hovering by an astronaut, who is writing in an open book.
sound: Jazzy lofi instrumental. Warm keys, a chilled beat, and a soulful bluesy guitar solo. For late night focus or a rainy day.

title: Kintsugi
intro: Kintsugi. Broken, mended in gold, better for it.
cover: A close up of a cracked astronaut visor, the cracks glowing like molten gold.
